node.title: XR deficient window: packed four-fiber plane payment
node.statement: At the tuple-incidence boundary, a stratum whose two selected blocks both have exact phi profile (ell,ell,1) uses four fixed full fibers and two points from a tail of size t=e-4ell in [2,sigma+2]. There are 6t individual block geometries, every target contributes two, and each fixed block owns at most three targets on an affine plane. Hence |Tau_pack| B_(s-2)<=9t binom(n-e,s-2). At the next dimensions this lies below the local allowance for every official tail. The bound is stratum-local and is not additive across mixed profiles or higher dimensions.
